verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a JavaScript UI framework. It does not hold or analyze a user's data inside a product interface, so in-product AI insights from user data are a category error for this kind of product. The llms.txt documentation bundle serves docs to LLMs. It is not an in-product insights feature and does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
